name: session-flow
description: Session discipline for long build sessions: a context guard that warns the user past ~90% of the window, asks the model once to wrap up when it is about to stop above that, and re-arms after each auto-compaction (PostToolUse + Stop + SessionStart, zero model tokens); a memory-review nudge after each git commit; and /roadmap for kickoff-ready task briefs under docs/roadmap/, each carrying a permanent numeric ID in its filename.
